  • Fund Raising party for Senator Edward Kennedy in Los Angel for 1986 presidential election. — 2016-02-03 · B

  • Formosan Association for Public Affair was established in Los Angeles. — 2016-02-03 · B
  • 20,000 immigration quota annually was given to the people from Taiwan. Thus, it open the gate for non-student Taiwanese immigrants to the U. S. through their direct relatives and other emigration channels. — 2016-02-03 · B

  • U.S. was found. There are more than 60 local chapters in the U. S. joined the association. — 2016-02-03 · B
  • Majority of Taiwanese students decided to stay in the U. S. after obtained their advance degrees. — 2016-02-03 · B
  • Some Taiwanese students were in a國民黨 black list and were not allowed to return to their home land. — 2016-02-03 · B
